comments.note: Gold Nugget: With this migration, all three manifest consumers in utils/ (workflow-helpers.ts, pipeline-maps.ts, constants.ts) now uniformly import from the Zod singleton. The pattern is architecturally sound — Zod parsing at module-load time guarantees compile-time type safety and startup-time validation of the manifest. This is preferable to using createRequire, which returns untyped `any` and defers validation to runtime callsites.
